name: YJ MGC3 Beta 3x3 Aero (MagLev + UV)
description: The YJ MGC3 Beta 3x3 Aero (MagLev + UV) is a lightweight, reimagined take on YJ's flagship platform, engineered for speedcubers who prefer a nimble, low-inertia feel. Featuring strategically hollowed-out internal piece geometry, the Aero trims the overall weight down to an agile 72 grams without sacrificing structural integrity.
